log.detail: Vertical 1080x1920, warm and cozy mood, subtitles on, voiceover required.

history.summary: Split follows time spent, with a small lift for Sora because the client asked for two voiceover re-records.

reasons.text: Wrote script v1 and two client-driven revisions (165 minutes total).
Final script was tightened to fit 28 seconds, as the client asked.
Most time on the job: four edit cuts plus export (265 minutes).
Fixed subtitles to one line after client feedback.
Recorded the voiceover and delivered the best take.
Re-recorded the full voiceover twice for a warmer tone, as the client asked.

disputes.text: I should get 70% because editing is the hardest part.
disputes.answer: No change: Jun's dispute asks for 70% because editing is hard, which is a claim about the role and not evidence. The log (e07, e09, e11, e13, e14) shows 265 minutes of edit work, and v1 already counted all of it and the subtitle fix (e08, e09).
